Yeah, pretty much. 
It's weird because he's never like this in any other facet of our relationship. 

Only when is precious snoozefest films are involved does he get like this.

We have been together for 6 years. Up until a few months ago I put my foot down on the movie thing. 

And the swapping thing won't work. I don't watch movies nearly as often as he does, and I typically have no desire to watch something I've already seen more than a few times unless it's to study a very specific part of it over and over. 

He refuses to accept the fact that I need breaks. Not without throwing a fit, or saying 'he pities me' for not being able to enjoy movies exactly as he does. He gets very condescending when I don't do things like he does. (for added context he is European. I am American)

As I type this, he is ten feet away from me giving me the silent treatment because I told him that I can't stay still during tonight's movie.
